incident: After Lossless v0.10.0 was installed and loaded, OpenClaw security audit still warned that the plugin install metadata recorded lossless-claw 0.9.2 while the installed package was 0.10.0. A dry-run of openclaw plugins update lossless-claw would have downgraded to 0.9.2 because the stale install record was pinned to the old spec.
lesson: For plugin metadata drift after a targeted plugin upgrade, do not run a broad update or trust a dry-run that points at the stale spec. Back up installs.json, use an exact pinned install with --force --pin for the intended version, refresh the registry, restart the gateway, then verify inspect/list/status.
durable_fix: Backed up installs.json, ran openclaw plugins install --force --pin @martian-engineering/lossless-claw@0.10.0, refreshed the plugin registry, restarted the gateway, and reran status/plugin/LCM/cron verification.
